webhook.title: Webhook Notifications
webhook.dingtalk.help: Add a custom robot in your DingTalk group (Robots & Plugins), then paste its Webhook URL and sign secret below.
webhook.wechat.help: Add a group robot in WeCom group settings (Group Robots), then paste its Webhook URL below.
webhook.feishu.help: Add a custom bot in your Feishu group settings (signature verification recommended), then paste its Webhook URL and secret below.
webhook.slack.help: Configure an Incoming Webhook for your Slack App, then paste the Webhook URL below.
webhook.discord.help: Create a Webhook in your Discord channel (Integrations → Webhooks), then paste the URL below.
webhook.telegram.help: Create a bot via @BotFather and use https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/sendMessage as the webhook URL.
webhook.teams.help: Create a URL via Power Automate or incoming webhook connectors in Microsoft Teams (Adaptive Cards format).
webhook.generic.help: Pushes JSON POST notifications to any endpoint - ideal for custom integrations.
webhook.secret.placeholder: Sign secret (optional, required for signed DingTalk robots)
webhook.secret.placeholder.dingtalk: Sign secret (starts with SEC, required for signed robots)
webhook.secret.placeholder.feishu: Sign secret (required when signature verification is enabled)
webhook.urlRequired: Please enter a valid http(s) URL
webhook.events.title: Subscribe to config-change events
webhook.events.help: When checked, a notification will be pushed to the configured webhook endpoints whenever the event occurs.
